description: Make a QR code for a link or any text, as SVG or PNG. Without an output path the SVG is returned as text. The content lives in the code itself, so it never expires.

format.description: Defaults to the output file's extension, or svg.

level.description: Error correction: L 7%, M 15%, Q 25%, H 30%. Defaults to M.

output.description: File to save, ending in .svg or .png.

overwrite.description: Replace the output file if it already exists. Defaults to false.

text.description: The link or text to encode.

name: qr_code
title: Make a QR code
